paras: Cyrtodactylus caovansungi is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Vietnam.
The specific name, caovansungi, is in honor of Vietnamese biologist Cao Van Sung.
C. caovansungi is found in southern Vietnam, in Ninh Thuan Province
The preferred natural habitat of C. caovansungi is forest at an altitude of 400 m (1,300 ft).
Relatively large for its genus, C. caovansungi may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 9.4 cm (3.7 in), plus a tail length of 12 cm (4.7 in).
